name: Extra themes
description: Five additional themes: Northern Night (dark blue-gray), Forest (dark green), Graphite (dark gray with orange), Warm Paper (cream) and Rose Dawn (light rose). Version 2.0 also colors the binder, editor, index cards and composition mode in program versions from 0.5.0 on.
author: Quillbinder
whatsNew: Two new themes: Graphite and Rose Dawn
All themes now set the colors of the editor, corkboard, index cards and composition mode (needs program version 0.5.0; older versions use the window colors only)
